description: Set the starting timecode (zero point) of a sequence and read it back. The value is snapped to the sequence frame grid; for drop-frame 29.97, 01;00;00;00 is 3599.9964 s, and for non-drop 29.97 it is 3603.6 s.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses active sequence if omitted.

start_seconds.description: Start time in seconds for the timecode origin (0 or more)

name: set_zero_point

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Zero Point
